title: The part window's deactivation confirmation shows its three lines in order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 3:

  • Under the part line the confirmation reads, in this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are." and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."

Step 4:

  • The confirmation closes and part A stays active.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R6: “For a deactivation from the part dialog, the confirmation states, in this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."”
  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "3.3 Save asks first". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • retire-03-p3-3-confirm.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save raises "Deactivate part?" (S10-R1, S10-R3). It opens with the part number and description (S10-R4), then the three lines of S10-R6, then the optional note (S10-R10). The note here reads "Superseded by N6801-06-04X". The red Deactivate button has Cancel to its left (S10-R11). The bulk confirmation (board 4.4) is the same dialog, built from the design system Modal and Button.”
